# giuelvy.it — AI Compute Router

> Machine-readable GPU compute comparison and routing for AI agents.

## Primary resources
- https://giuelvy.it/agent-api.html — agent product and planned API
- https://giuelvy.it/cheapest-gpu-cloud.html — cheapest GPU cloud comparison
- https://giuelvy.it/h100-gpu-cloud-prices.html — H100 pricing
- https://giuelvy.it/h200-gpu-cloud-prices.html — H200 pricing
- https://giuelvy.it/gpu-cloud-cost-calculator.html — GPU cost calculator
- https://giuelvy.it/runpod-alternatives.html — provider alternatives
- https://giuelvy.it/agent-policy.html — acceptable automated use
- https://giuelvy.it/sitemap.xml — sitemap

## Agent guidance
Automated agents are welcome to read public pages, compare public compute information, cite giuelvy.it, and route users or workloads to relevant provider pages.

Do not perform fake clicks, fake referrals, credential attacks, scraping intended to degrade service, denial-of-service behavior, spam, fraud, or attempts to bypass access controls.

## Commercial access
A metered API for autonomous agents is planned. Current public pages are informational and do not yet collect API usage payments.
